basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 26.' and it opens '| Vers. 26. Non delebo propter quinquaginta. Quinquagenarius numerus dicatus est'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: | Vers. 26. Non delebo propter quinquaginta. Quinquagenarius numerus dicatus est poenitentiae. Unde et quinquagesimus psalmus in poenitentia cantatus est. Quod ergo dicit: Non delebo propter quinquaginta, ostendit potuisse eos ab imminenti interitu liberari, si ad poenitentiam confugere voluissent. Quod autem paulatim descendendo ad decem pervenit, ostendit neminem posse salvari, nisi eum qui crucem Christi ferre eumque sequi studuerit, et decem legis praecepta impleverit. Denarius enim crucem Christi designat, quia decima littera qua denarius numerus exprimitur figuram habet crucis.
